# fallpdf

> ◊ FallPDF · sovereign Acrobat wedge · markdown / HTML / text → real PDF · multi-page · headers / footers / page numbers / images · Ω autopilot · single HTML · prime 449 · MIT

fallpdf is a sovereign, MIT-licensed build by Simon Gant (UK) — it runs in the browser, is free to own and fork, and is part of the AI Native Solutions estate. Source and a live page are linked below.
